//: R7.2 — Core Web Vitals budgets, gated in CI.
Runs against ./dist via lhci's own static server, so it measures the same
bytes GitHub Pages serves. Left on Lighthouse's default mobile form factor
and 4x-CPU / Slow-4G throttling, because 'good on mobile' is the stated
requirement and the desktop preset would quietly relax it.
Note INP is a field metric and cannot be measured in a lab run; total-
blocking-time is the standard lab proxy and is asserted in its place.
Chromium comes from the Playwright install — the `lhci` npm script exports
CHROME_PATH so it is found in-container and on a host machine alike.
